instruction: Open Thunderbird, navigate to the Bills folder, locate the most recent email, and launch its first link in Chrome with the tab set to active.

metadata.explanation: This variation checks that the active tab in Chrome is the Amazon URL after opening the link from the Thunderbird email. The instruction asks to open the link and make it active. The evaluator uses the existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify that the active tab URL matches https://www.amazon.com/.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the active tab URL matches the expected Amazon URL
The active_tab_info getter can successfully extract the active tab information from Chrome
The metric logic correctly compares URLs using compare_urls function for robust URL matching
The evaluator appropriately verifies the final state (active tab with Amazon URL) which can only be achieved by completing all instruction steps
Expected URL (https://www.amazon.com/) is semantically correct for the task - this is the link that should be opened from the Thunderbird email
Complete verification coverage: the instruction's ultimate goal is to have the Amazon link open and active, which is exactly what the evaluator checks
